name: 영어 기초개념 다지기 💡 later / after / in

keywords.ko: 나중에, 이따가
※현시점에서 <시간의 양> 후에 / 뒤에  (며칠 뒤에, 일주일에 뒤에)에선 쓰지 않음.

keywords.en: ex) They first me in 2008. (Just) A few years later, they got married.
keywords.ko: 과거에 시점에서 몇년 뒤에 이렇게는 사용함

keywords.en: (they got married just a few years later)
keywords.ko: My family and I came back to Korea in 1994. Just a few years later, the IMF crisis hit. So, the timing wasn’t so good for us. ⇒ 과거에 일을 얘기할 때는 later을 사용하기도 함
later가 못쓰는 현시점을 기준으로 후에, 뒤에 라고 써야할 때 사용
5분 뒤에 보자. I’ll see you five minutes later  ⇒  I’ll see you in five minutes./ I’ll see you in a couple of days.
1시간 뒤에 다시 전화할게요.  I’ll call you back in an hour.
after 와 in의 차이는 → 뉘앙스가 약간 차이가 있음.
5분 후에/ 뒤에 [ 5분 후에 어떤 일이 일어날 때)
5분이 지나면(지나고 나면) [5분의 시간이 지나면서 어떤 변화가 생길 때]

keywords.en: After ten years, everyone will forget about it.
keywords.ko: 몇 년 지나면(지나고 나면) 다들 잊을거야
과거나 미래에 대한 일 모두 활용 가능
이따가 봐
5분뒤에 보자
이따가 다시 전화 할게
1시간 뒤에 전화할게
그들은 2008년에 처음 만났다. 몇 년 후에 그들은 결혼을 했다.
나의 가족은 1994년 한국에 돌아왔다. 몇 년 후의 IMF위기가 찾아왔다.
몇 년 지나면(지나고 나면) 다들 잊을거야.

keywords.en: I’ll call you back in an hour
They first met in 2008. (Just) A few years later, they got married
My family and I came back to Korea in 1994, Just a few years later, the IMF crisis hit.
After ten years, everyone will forget about it.

keywords.ko: 나중에 할게.

keywords.en: I'll do it in an hour.
keywords.ko: 한 시간 후에 할게.
저녁 먹고 할게.

keywords.en: I'll eat dinner. After that, I'll study.
keywords.ko: 저녁 먹고, 그다음에 공부할게.

keywords.en: I'll be there in an hour.
The train leaves in ten minutes.
After the game, we went home.
First, we'll eat. After that, we'll get coffee.
I worked out. After that, I took a shower.
We visited the museum. After that, we had dinner.
Finish this first. After that, you can relax.

my_sentences.en: 1. Don't worry.  after a couple of weeks, his condition will get better.
2. In just a few months, we will have a new president.
3. I'm moving to a new apartment in a few weeks.
4. It was a little awkward at first but I got the hang of it later a couple of hours.
I'll be back in ten minutes.
The movie starts in an hour.
Dinner will be ready in five minutes.
I'll see you in a week.
We'll leave in a little while.
I'll text you in a few minutes.

my_sentences.ko: 3. after :~ 후에 (무언가가 끝난 다음을 말할 때 사용합니다.)

my_sentences.en: I'll take a shower after I exercise.
She always drinks coffee after lunch.
He fell asleep after watching TV.
We had dinner. After that, we went for a walk.
my_sentences.ko: 앞에서 말한 일이 끝난 뒤의 다음 순서를 말할 때 사용합니다.

my_sentences.en: I finished my homework. After that, I watched TV.
She took a shower. After that, she went to bed.
First, we'll have a meeting. After that, we'll have lunch.
He graduated. After that, he got a job.
We cleaned the house. After that, we relaxed.
I packed my bags. After that, I left.
Finish your work. After that, you can go home.
